findingClass: an active field_source_overrides row is past its expiry with no expired_at flag, or is no longer valid against the current manifest (an incapable source, or S-05 document-on-timetable-field, after a manifest drift since the row was set)
whatItAsks: every field_source_overrides row with expired_at IS NULL is either genuinely still time-active AND valid against the current manifest, or is flagged expired
healthy: 0 violations across every non-administratively-expired override row
alarmsWhen: a row's expires_at is in the past with expired_at still null, or a still-time-active row ranks a source the current manifest marks incapable, or ranks a document source on an E-1/class-T timetable field
scope: every row in field_source_overrides with expired_at IS NULL, on whichever database the audit runs against
consumerReason: an override is a same-day production knob with no PR in front of it (Tier A, per the card) — the nightly floor is the only recurring check that a manifest drift since a row was set has not silently invalidated it
note: a missing field_source_overrides table (prod, before this slice's migration ships there) is reported PASS, not UNVERIFIABLE or FAIL -- layer 2 is simply absent on that database, matching the resolver's own table-absent tolerance.
